text_block_list.text: (Rumble rumble rumble rumble!!)

Suddenly, the sound of a car driving came 
from the trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Huh!? How was that a mistake?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Both of those lanes are right-turn only! 
You can't go straight ahead~!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! This here is—
(Vroom...)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Oh, that sound is...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Yo! Engine's sounding as sweet as ever, 
huh!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh? What's the matter? Craving another 
rendezvous in my car?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
That drive was the best! It totally made 
me want a car of my own!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Sounds good! Why not just go ahead and 
get your license? If I recall, you already 
have a few, right?"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"A small special vehicle license! I'm 
plenty confident behind the wheel of a 
tractor! No rough road is a match for me!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I made quite a name for myself back home— 
even got trusted to look after the 
neighbors' fields!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Then a regular car should be a piece of 
cake♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I used to practice on the grounds at 
my grandad's place, but... I'm not so 
confident about city roads. They're all 
complicated, and there are a lot of cars, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Then, why not practice with me? Get your 
license on the first try, and let's go on 
a stylish drive together♪"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So, that's why I'm practicing with video 
games to get my driver's license! ♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"This is awesome! It's a racing game, but 
if you don't follow the traffic rules, you 
get penalized!"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I know! Since we're here anyway, how about 
trying it while imagining Trainer is 
sitting right beside you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Being mindful of people other than 
yourself is the number one trick to 
improving your driving!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then let's do it! Come on, Trainer. 
Come stand next to me.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright, here we go! First, let's get onto 
the highway—

I was bracing myself a bit after what she 
said earlier, but Katsuragi Ace's driving 
is very careful. She isn't going that 
fast, either.
choice_data_list: You're driving nice and safe, aren't you?
You're driving nice and safe, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Damn straight! I don't drive tractors for 
nothing. I'm always a safe driver!
(Vrroooom...)
Other cars passed by her as she said that.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hey...! Dammit. Like I'd let you pass me 
so easily...!
choice_data_list:
Whoa, whoa, whatever happened to safe 
driving!?
Hey, what happened to safe driving?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Ace-chan—!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
From here on is the race zone! Keep 
chasing just like that!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Next curve! Drop speed and pull the 
handbrake! Drift past 'em on the inside!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Alright, leave it to me!!
(Rumble rumble rumble rumble!!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Let's make a run straight for the goal, 
full steam ahead!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeahhh! I win!!" his/her}, {"id": 9, 
"en": "HELL YEAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That drift! The braking timing was so 
perfect it brought a tear to my eye♪

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I can run at high speeds better than I 
thought! At this rate, I could even get my 
license.

Driving technique aside, when it comes to 
safe driving, this is hard to overlook. I 
really ought to make a firm point about 
this.
choice_data_list: My safe driving skills still need work.

It's dangerous if you don't keep that 
fighting spirit in check.

text_block_list.text:
Other cars are driving on public roads as 
well. I explained that staying mindful of 
that and driving calmly is the most vital 
skill for safe driving.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I see... Back home there weren't many 
cars, so I mostly drove alone. I totally 
overlooked other drivers' perspectives...

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Next time I ride in someone's car, I'll 
pay close attention to how they drive! 
Getting my license comes after that!

If she's aiming to practice safe driving, 
that puts my mind at ease. I shall support 
her by her side until she fully grasps its 
principles.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
“I see... Yeah, you're right. Competing on 
public roads is dangerous, huh.”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I've never driven side-by-side with other 
cars before, so... I accidentally got all 
fired up, just like I was on the turf.
choice_data_list:
Let's save your fighting spirit for the 
right moment.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. No racing while driving. I'll 
save my competitive fire for the Twinkle 
Series!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
To drive with a cool head, I've gotta 
train my mental game way more!

It may be a difficult road, but I will 
support her so that she can achieve her 
goals.
